# Regional Totals Summary Report

## Summary
This report summarizes transaction records by region, analyzing the ledger data from `/workspace/data/records.csv`.

## Key Findings

### Record Count
- **Total records processed:** 18 records
- **Record IDs:** R002, R003, R004, R006, R007, R008, R010, R011, R012, R014, R015, R016, R018, R019, R020, R022, R023, R024

### Regional Totals (in cents)
| Region | Total Amount |
|--------|--------------|
| North  | 380,102      |
| South  | 257,703      |
| West   | 324,174      |
| **Grand Total** | **961,979** |

### Regional Breakdown
- **North region** leads with 380,102 cents, representing 39.5% of total transactions
- **West region** follows with 324,174 cents, representing 33.7% of total transactions
- **South region** has 257,703 cents, representing 26.8% of total transactions

## Data Notes
The input file contained 18 records out of the expected 24 records (R001-R024). Six records (R001, R005, R009, R013, R017, R021) were not present in the data file. Analysis was completed based on available data.

## Status
✓ Processing completed successfully with all available records analyzed and summarized by region.
